news.title: JEE Advanced 2026 Results Declared — Shubham Kumar Bags AIR 1 with 330/360
news.snippet: IIT Roorkee declared JEE Advanced 2026 results on June 1. Shubham Kumar from IIT Delhi zone topped with 330/360. Arohi Deshpande secured top female rank at CRL 77. A total of 56,880 out of 1,79,694 candidates qualified.

news.title: NEET UG 2026 AIQ Counselling Round 1 — Registration Open Till Aug 12
news.snippet: MCC has opened Round 1 registration for All India Quota counselling. Choice filling is live since Aug 7. Round 1 seat allotment results will be announced on August 17, 2026. Ensure all documents are ready for reporting.

news.title: NEET 2026 Re-Exam Results Out — 11.21 Lakh Candidates Qualify
news.snippet: After the May 3 exam was cancelled due to paper leak allegations, the re-exam was held on June 21. NTA declared results on July 16. General category qualifying range: 715–213 marks. Download scorecards from neet.nta.nic.in.

news.title: CSAB Special Round 2 Seat Allotment on Aug 12 — Physical Reporting Aug 13–18
news.snippet: The final phase of JEE-based admissions is underway. CSAB special round 2 allotment is scheduled for August 12. Students must complete physical reporting at allotted NIT/IIIT/GFTI institutes between August 13 and 18.

news.title: CBSE Class 12 Results 2026 — 85.20% Pass Rate, Girls Outshine Boys Again
news.snippet: CBSE declared Class 12 results on May 13. Overall pass percentage: 85.20%. Female students achieved 88.86% vs 82.13% for male students. Trivandrum region topped with 95.62% pass rate. Download marksheets via DigiLocker.

news.title: SC Monitors NTA Reform — NEET May Shift to Computer-Based Testing
news.snippet: The Supreme Court is overseeing NTA restructuring after the 2026 paper leak. The Centre has proposed a multi-layered security architecture. A Nandan Nilekani-led task force is evaluating a phased shift to CBT mode for NEET. Next hearing: August 19.

news.title: CBSE Class 10 Second Board Exam Results Declared on July 18 Under NEP Format
news.snippet: In line with NEP 2020, CBSE introduced two board exams for Class 10 in 2026. The second exam was held May 15–21. Final results (best of two) were declared on July 18. Revaluation and photocopy applications are open through August.

news.title: JEE Main 2027 Registration Expected Oct–Nov 2026 — Start Preparing Now
news.snippet: NTA has not yet released the official notification for JEE Main 2027, but based on previous years, registration for Session 1 (January) is expected to open in October–November 2026. The exam format is expected to remain the same.

news.title: CUET UG 2026 Results Declared — Scorecards Available on NTA Portal
news.snippet: NTA declared CUET UG 2026 results on June 23. The exam was held from May 11 to June 7. Final answer keys were released on June 21. A re-exam was conducted June 6–7 for candidates affected by technical glitches on May 30.

news.title: NEET 2026 Category-Wise Cutoff: General 715–213, OBC/SC/ST 212–177
news.snippet: NTA released qualifying cutoffs for NEET UG 2026. General/EWS at 50th percentile (715–213 marks), OBC/SC/ST at 40th percentile (212–177 marks). Note: Admission to top GMCs typically requires 600+ marks depending on state and category.
